title: Vignette 2026-10-30: a decision records its rationale and how we would know it was wrong

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Owner, 2026-10-30, after choosing option B for the RFC-049 registry: "ok. looks like B is still the way. 

Lets record a clear rationale. 

How would we tell whether we made the wrong decision or need to change?"
